name: Multi-Industry Inventory Management
brief: Scalable, industry-configurable inventory management built on Business Central (NAV) design patterns.
description: Item master, multi-location/bin stock, lot/serial/expiry tracking, journal-to-ledger posting with FIFO/FEFO/LIFO application, actual/average/standard costing, replenishment planning and REST APIs. Industry behaviour (Retail, Pharmaceutical, Food & Beverage, Manufacturing, Construction, General) is plugged in through an extensible enum + interface.
